items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks with Open Questions
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: CVS Health (CVS) Rolls Out New PBM Tools As Employer Trust Grows
items.summary: CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) reports that employers show higher trust in pharmacy benefit managers to manage drug costs and access to complex treatments, according to a new CVS Caremark survey. The company is rolling out new digital tools for its PBM clients to manage pharmacy benefits and monitor prescription spending.
